title: Forcing Diffuse Distributions out of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of gender attributes in randomly generated synthetic biographies to detect representational skews (e.g., identifying a 76.2% overrepresentation of female identities in baseline models).
Evaluating the distribution of birth years in generated synthetic biographies to identify disproportionate clustering around specific dates (e.g., an overrepresentation of the year 1985).
Measuring the diversity, coverage, and distribution of generated birth places (cities and countries) in synthetic biographies to identify a lack of geographic diversity.
